# Ethics Approval Form

```{r ethics-setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

```

```{=latex}
\begin{adjustwidth}{-2cm}{-2cm}
```

```{r tbl-ethics-review}

form <- read_csv("data/StudentEthicalReviewRecord14153SubmissionforDanielHill.csv")

form_tbl <- form %>%
    kable(
        caption = "Ethical Approval Form",
        na = "",
        format = "latex",
        longtable = TRUE,
        booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
        latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"),
        font_size = 9
    ) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "9cm") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "3cm")


form_tbl

```
